mobile_ux_issues: Homepage 'Free Estimate' modal forces mobile visitors into a blind 3-field Forminator callback form (Name, Phone, Street Address) with zero instant price range or roof scope selection
Both homepage and /contact/ Forminator forms ship with inline style='display: none;' until client-side JS initializes, compounding perceived lag on mobile
Contact page asks visitors to pick an inspection date and time slot without first providing a ballpark replacement budget or material comparison
seo_or_speed_leaks: Slow 1,935 ms initial server TTFB and bloated 419 KB homepage HTML payload carrying overlapping WordPress builder footprints (Elementor and Divi remnants)
33 of 58 homepage images remain in legacy JPG/PNG formats instead of modern WebP/AVIF
18 of 58 homepage images have missing or empty alt attributes, and 1 render-blocking script loads in <head>
technical_audit.current_lead_capture_method: Static Forminator 3-field modal form (Name, Phone, Street Address) on homepage and 5-field scheduling form on /contact/, plus click-to-call phone CTA

trojan_horse_angle.pitch_hook_english: Your Austin site already pulls in local roof replacement traffic, but homeowners clicking 'Free Estimate' hit a blind 3-field address form with no instant ballpark range before handing over their phone number.
